title: Discount approval on quotes
transcript:
Consultant: Are there limits on what a rep can discount?
Client: There are supposed to be. Anything over twenty percent needs a
director to sign off, but reps just do it anyway and we find out at invoicing.
Consultant: So you want the system to stop them.
Client: Yes. A quote with a discount over twenty percent should not be
saveable unless a director has approved it. Block the save with a clear message.
Consultant: Understood, that is a validation rule rather than a field.
Client: Whatever it is called, make it stop them.

expected.note: A validation rule on Quote, not a field. Object is named, field is not applicable.

notes: Tests that an object-level rule is extracted with a null field name rather than an invented one.
